previous_statement: Conclusion and universal constants. After nodes #0,#2,#3,#5 are validated, take a_merge to be the minimum of the universal admissible radii in the four-corner datum/compression construction and e_corner,e_norm,e_cov, and take C_merge=max{3,D_mult,K_norm} (enlarged harmlessly to cover the standard admissible ambient epsilon ceiling). Nodes #0 and #2 show every amplification is a C_merge(rho+epsilon)-homomorphism, node #3 gives its two-sided (1 plus-or-minus C_merge(rho+epsilon)) norm bounds, and node #5 gives bijectivity of the single level-one map. By def-extended-delta-inclusion this is one extended C_merge(rho+epsilon)-isomorphism, proving the root contract.
new_statement: Conclusion and universal constants. After nodes 1.1,1.3,1.4,1.6 are validated, let e_* be the minimum of e_corner,e_norm,e_cov,1/(2K_norm), and the universal admissible radius inherent in the compressed-corner/four-corner definitions. Fix the standard ambient epsilon ceiling at e_*/2 and take a_merge=e_*/2, so rho<=a_merge gives e=rho+epsilon<=e_*. Set C_merge=max{3,D_mult,K_norm}. Nodes 1.1 and 1.3 show every amplification is a C_merge e-homomorphism, node 1.4 gives its two-sided (1 plus-or-minus C_merge e) norm bounds, and node 1.6 gives bijectivity of the single level-one map. By def-extended-delta-inclusion this is one extended C_merge(rho+epsilon)-isomorphism, proving the root contract in the definitions standard universal small-error regime.
